Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Referred Sections: Second or Greater Recurrent Disc Herniation

Required findings: Candidate for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608: Lumbar Decompression.
Imaging must demonstrate ANY of the following:

- Degenerative spondylolisthesis without spondylolysis with either dynamic segmental instability on flexion‑extension plain x‑rays or supine‑upright translational difference >3 mm, OR Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis.
- Spondylolisthesis with spondylolysis (isthmic) with either Meyerding Grade I‑II plus radiographic progression, OR Meyerding Grade III‑IV with ≥50 % anterior slippage or documented progression.
- Progressive spinal pain with imaging that shows progression of spondylolisthesis.
- Multi‑level spondylolysis on plain x‑rays.
- Post‑operative instability from facet joint excision exceeding 50 % bilaterally or ≥75 % of a single facet.
- Pars fracture.
- Prior lumbar decompression that produced iatrogenic spondylolisthesis.
Exception: If instability is identified intra‑operatively, imaging criteria are not required.
Documented nicotine‑free status – either never‑smoker or abstinent ≥6 weeks with a normal cotinine test (serum, urine, or saliva).
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression > Actual Instability

Required findings: Candidate for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608: Lumbar Decompression.
Anticipated iatrogenic instability must be present with ANY of the following:
- Facet joint excision >50 % bilaterally or >75 % of a single facet during decompression.
- Removal of the pars interarticularis that would require fusion for stability.
- Decompression performed for Meyerding Grade I or higher spondylolisthesis with foraminal stenosis.
- Complete or partial corpectomy involving removal of ≥1/3 of a vertebral body (excluding osteophyte‑only resections).
Documented nicotine‑free status – either never‑smoker or abstinent ≥6 weeks with a normal cotinine test (serum, urine, or saliva).
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression > Anticipated Iatrogenic Instability

Required findings: Candidate for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608: Lumbar Decompression.
Imaging must demonstrate EITHER a coronal plane deformity OR a sagittal imbalance:
- Coronal deformity: Cobb angle >30°, asymmetric disc collapse causing symptomatic foraminal narrowing, or global coronal imbalance with head/trunk shift off midline.
- Sagittal imbalance: sagittal vertical axis >8 cm or pelvic incidence‑lumbar lordosis mismatch >15°.
Documented nicotine‑free status – either never‑smoker or abstinent ≥6 weeks with a normal cotinine test (serum, urine, or saliva).
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression > Adult Symptomatic Degenerative Spinal Deformity

Required findings: Candidate for an initial primary lumbar discectomy per CMM-606.2 (Microdiscectomy/Laminotomy/Laminectomy).
Advanced imaging must show ANY of the following scenarios:
- Primary extraforaminal disc herniation at L5‑S1 where a far‑lateral approach is not feasible because of the iliac wings.
- Primary foraminal disc herniation that requires facet resection, which would create iatrogenic instability.
- Primary disc herniation at the level of the spinal cord (low‑lying conus medullaris).
Documented nicotine‑free status – either never‑smoker or abstinent ≥6 weeks with a normal cotinine test (serum, urine, or saliva).
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression > Initial Disc Herniation

Required findings: Candidate for repeat lumbar discectomy per CMM-606.3 at the same level.
Imaging must demonstrate anterolisthesis at the requested level(s) with EITHER:
- Dynamic segmental instability on flexion‑extension plain x‑rays or supine‑upright translational difference >3 mm.
- Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis.
Documented nicotine‑free status – either never‑smoker or abstinent ≥6 weeks with a normal cotinine test (serum, urine, or saliva).
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression > Recurrent Disc Herniation
